common_prompt:
Use the uploaded sheep as the exact character reference: same proportions, cream color, kaomoji face (two black dot eyes and a small "ω" mouth), floppy ears, wool tuft and green leaf. Do not redesign it.
Create a sprite sheet: ONE horizontal row of N equal square frames, each frame 512x512, no gaps, no borders.
The sheep is centered and the same size in every frame (about 75% of frame height), feet always on the same baseline near the bottom. Props must stay inside the frame.
Flat 2D vector, no outline, crisp hard edges, no motion blur, no glow, no semi-transparent shadows, no ground, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. Transparent background.
Props use only these flat colors: deep green #1F514A, soft green #7FB89A, warm gold #D8A33A, tomato red #D9573F, pale blue #A9CFE8, white.
Action (N = {frames}): {action_prompt}

actions.name: idle
actions.trigger: 平常待機
actions.prompt: front 3/4 view, gentle breathing, body rises and falls slightly (outline changes less than 3%), fixed head proportions, the leaf bends gently but always stays attached on the same side of the tuft

actions.name: walk_right
actions.trigger: 在桌面巡邏（朝左由 Claude 鏡像產生 walk_left）
actions.prompt: side view facing right, happy bouncy walk, legs alternate, body bobs, ears flop

actions.name: drag
actions.trigger: 滑鼠拖曳
actions.prompt: lifted by the scruff, dangling in the air, legs swinging, surprised round "o" mouth; the scruff stretches only slightly, keep the rounded head and short cloud-like tuft, never cone-shaped or pointed

actions.name: sleep
actions.trigger: 下班安靜時段、全螢幕投影上課時
actions.prompt: lying down on its side, curled into a round wool ball with legs tucked into the wool, eyes as short curved lines, slow breathing (body rises and falls slightly); no z shapes, no letters

actions.name: listen
actions.trigger: 按住右 Ctrl／右 Alt 語音輸入錄音中
actions.prompt: head tilted toward a small microphone, one ear raised, small sound-wave arcs near the ear

actions.name: think
actions.trigger: AI 或語音整理中、AI 行政助理分析中
actions.prompt: shuffles and sorts a small stack of papers, looks up, three dots appear one by one above the head

actions.name: success
actions.trigger: 任務完成、語音變任務、各種操作成功
actions.prompt: stamps a round green check-mark stamp on a paper, then jumps up happily with sparkles

actions.name: warning
actions.trigger: 一般提醒、出錯時
actions.prompt: fixed front view in every frame, small alert hop, a bold exclamation mark shape appears close above the tuft, ears perk up; crouch frames stay at least 85% of standing height, shallow hop

actions.name: peek
actions.trigger: 走到螢幕邊緣探頭
actions.prompt: only the head and front hooves peek in from the right edge of the frame, look around, then slide back out

actions.name: greet
actions.trigger: 開機時的開場簡報
actions.prompt: waves hello with the same front hoof (its left front hoof) in every frame while the other front hoof stays down, happy face; a small gold sun rises gradually above the head across the frames instead of appearing suddenly

actions.name: overdue
actions.trigger: 任務逾期提醒
actions.prompt: holds up a small desk calendar with one day circled in tomato red, worried face, small hop

actions.name: idle_blink
actions.trigger: 待機時隨機穿插
actions.prompt: front 3/4 view, same pose as idle, slow blink (eyes become short curved lines, then open again), very small head tilt; body outline changes less than 3%

actions.name: idle_grade
actions.trigger: 待機時隨機穿插（改作業）
actions.prompt: sitting, holding a small tomato-red pen, marking bold check marks on an open blank exercise book (no writing, no letters, only thick check marks), head nods slightly

actions.name: mail
actions.trigger: LINE 小幫手有新訊息待整理
actions.prompt: hugs a solid soft-green rounded speech-bubble shape (plain, no logo, no text, no dots inside), hops once, the bubble wiggles

actions.name: drink
actions.trigger: 喝水提醒、按「喝了」、右鍵「喝水 +1」
actions.prompt: holds a solid pale blue cup with both front hooves, lifts it and sips, happy closed curved eyes, then lowers the cup

actions.name: stretch
actions.trigger: 起身提醒、按「動過了」
actions.prompt: big stretch like a cat: front legs reach forward and down, back arches up, then stands up and shakes its wool; head keeps the same round shape

actions.name: medicine
actions.trigger: 服藥提醒
actions.prompt: taps a small solid gold alarm clock (blank face, no numbers) that rings with a few thick short vibration marks attached close to the clock, a small solid white pill box beside it

actions.name: focus
actions.trigger: 專注 25／50 分鐘模式中
actions.prompt: sitting and reading an open book with blank pages (no text), a small solid tomato-shaped timer beside it, pages turn slowly

actions.name: watch
actions.trigger: 分心提醒（滑 YouTube、IG 太久）
actions.prompt: holds solid deep-green binoculars up to its eyes, peeks toward the viewer, then lowers them and pouts

actions.name: note
actions.trigger: 記事存好、語音「說給小綿助」變記事
actions.prompt: draws two thick wavy lines (not letters) on a small solid gold square sticky note with a pencil, then sticks the note up beside itself

actions.name: sign
actions.trigger: 遙控教室大屏提示送出
actions.prompt: raises a small completely blank signboard (solid deep green board, white border, no text, no marks) above its head with both front hooves; the board stays inside the frame
